source.sqlReaderQuery: select ISNULL(max(batch_id),100) as batch_id from dbo.file_process_log_tbl

sqlReaderQuery.value:
select sum(cnt) as cnt from  
(select 1 as cnt
from dbo.file_process_log_tbl 
where file_name='@{pipeline().parameters.p_Employee_info_from_HR}.csv' and 
src_file_modify_dt='@{formatDateTime(json(activity('Web_emp').output.Response)[0].commit.author.date,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}'
union all
select 1  )t1

text.value:
INSERT INTO dbo.file_process_log_tbl
(
    batch_id,
    file_name,
    src_file_modify_dt,
    load_dt
)
SELECT
    @{activity('New_batch_id').output.firstRow.batch_id}+1 AS batch_id,
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_Employee_info_from_HR}.csv' AS file_name,
    '@{formatDateTime(json(activity('Web_emp').output.Response)[0].commit.author.date,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}' AS src_file_modify_dt,
    '@{utcNow('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}' AS load_dt;
